title: Hierarchical assembly of mixed 2D surfactants in polyHIPEs: tuning conductive networks through multi-scale structuring
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,22216-22226
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01377E, Paper
Open Access

Deep Shikha Srivastava, Elizabeth E. B. Brown, Deepthi Varghese, Douglas H. Adamson
Assembly of 2D surfactants within high internal phase emulsions (HIPEs) provides a route to multifunctional open-cell foams; here, the relationships between particle distribution, emulsion architecture, and macroscopic properties are investigated.
